name: Hollóháza (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue upper hoist part and a red lower fly part, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the municipal arms of Hollóháza (a green shield with a raven and a church, within a wreath) above the name HOLLÓHÁZA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
